reviews.title: Not designed for small businesses or sole proprietors.
reviews.text:
Not recommended! I started a sole proprietorship business as a side hustle, managing everything legally and legitimately. I opened a PayPal business account because there was no monthly fee and I could have my clients use their credit cards. After 2 weeks PayPal blocked my account and required more information about how my business worked and ran, I submitted and they replied the documents weren’t legible, please keep in mind I submitted PDF docs downloaded from supplier websites. 
After 5 days of my account being blocked and unavailable to send invoices or receive payments I lost a $24,000 job because of a construction schedule and timing. They will lock your account without warning and you’re dead in the water and waiting for them, they clearly have no idea how a sole proprietorship works and that a new business has little to no history of taxes and suppliers.

reviews.title: Working Capital
reviews.text: The working capital loan is just ridiculous. They offered it to me last year when my business was at a certain sales average. I paid it back within 90 days which was the estimated time. Mind you, you don’t have to pay it back in their estimated time, but I did. After that, I couldn’t get another one. They try to hype you off like you can, but my business has been higher than that, i’ve gotten excited and interviewed people thinking that I could get another loan and buy a station to put them in with another loan. I meet all requirements listed. Even the representatives that I talked to on the phone say that I look like I am eligible and just keep trying, but I’ve been trying for six months. It’s just a scam and a way to keep getting your information. I don’t even bother. I’ll be using a different platform that will help me grow my small individual business. PayPal doesn’t care.

reviews.title: Horrible for new businesses
reviews.text: Every single time I’ve gotten a payment over 2,000$ in my first year with PayPal I’ve had my account restricted and had to send the same 7 files over and over again to get access to the money. They single handily shut my business down for 18 days last year and 3 days this year. Do not use them if you don’t have a ton of years in business and super consistent pay, their going to pester you for invoices, recipes, “proof of business”, licensing and anything else they feel like and it takes a hour and a half of dealing with a horrible AI to finally speak to a human on the phone. Horrible service. I’ve shown 150k worth of sales last year that they took a good cut of and I’m apparently still a risk. You’re better off using square or any other POS system. These guys don’t care about you they just want that 3% cut.

It’s a useless service now as merchants do not use it any more, and they are dead without merchants. And now I can’t even open it to add money, which takes for ever, for the one or two subscriptions I still have linked to it. This is a dying company.
